name: Rahm Emanuel
role: US representative (2003–2009), White House chief of staff (2009–2010), Chicago mayor (2011–2019), and ambassador to Japan (2022–2025)
summary: Emanuel combines market-oriented economic development with public investment, higher minimum wages and expanded education access. He supports US alliances and deterrence, while his recent proposals would condition relations with Israel and end its US defense subsidy. His policing and school reforms have generated substantial controversy.
